mutations.name: L1 a restarted thread is adopted into the bound holder, which is exactly the state this PR opened in
mutations.expectRed: the plane KEEPS PUBLISHING after the restart

mutations.name: L2 the drain stops closing the old thread's run, so an observer is left holding a run that never ends
mutations.expectRed: and no run the dead thread opened was left open

mutations.name: L3 shutdown stops draining the plane, so a mid-turn exit publishes a run that is never closed
mutations.expectRed: a mid-turn exit CLOSES the run it left open

mutations.name: L4 the bind stops retrying at a turn boundary, so a seat whose rollout appeared late never publishes at all
mutations.expectRed: a rollout that appeared AFTER the launch gave up still binds

mutations.name: L5 the launch stops binding at all, so an armed seat publishes nothing on the ordinary path
mutations.expectRed: an armed seat PUBLISHES its thread's activity

mutations.name: L6 a dead emitter stays bound, so a seat whose broker was down at launch publishes nothing for the rest of its life
mutations.expectRed: broker-late:the next turn boundary REBINDS the dead plane

mutations.name: L8 giving up on a successor stops draining the predecessor at all, so a run whose process is gone is left open on the wire
mutations.expectRed: restart-late:the dead thread's run was CLOSED when the plane gave up on its successor

mutations.name: L7 the give-up drains the predecessor but stops CLEARING it, so every later boundary feeds a thread whose process is gone
mutations.expectRed: restart-late:the successor thread PUBLISHES once its file appears
